title: White car first seen
detail: 36 m before the impact point, moving at 22 km/h (4.5 s before impact).

title: Peak speed 49 ± 17 km/h
detail: White car was at its fastest 3.9 s before impact. Uncertainty comes from the road calibration (±30%).

title: Could it have stopped?
detail: 1.6 s before impact White car was at 16 km/h with 11.4 m to go. A full stop (1 s reaction + braking) needs 5.7 m. A stop was possible; the highest speed that would have allowed a stop is about 51 km/h.

title: Braking began 1.5 s before impact
detail: At 10 km/h with 10.7 m left to the impact point. Braking alone needs about 0.6 m to stop from that speed, so a stop was possible.

title: Vision model's reading (overruled)
detail: The grey car cut in front of the white car, forcing it to brake suddenly. The grey car then moved out of the way, leaving the white car in the middle of the intersection. This doesn't match what was measured (It drifted left on its own into the point of impact); the measurements stand.

title: Closest approach: Grey car
detail: Grey car came within 2.0 m of White car's body (3.0 m centre to centre) at T+0.4 s.
